newsitem.title: UK: CANADIAN PACIFIC TO ACQUIRE CONTSHIP UNIT.
newsitem.headline: CANADIAN PACIFIC TO ACQUIRE CONTSHIP UNIT.

text.p: Canadian Pacific Ltd said it has agreed in principle to acquire Contship Containerlines, the container shipping business of Contship Holdings NV.
Canadian Pacific said the deal would include Contship's brand name, services, world-wide organisation, container fleet and 19 chartered-in container vessels.
Not included in the transaction are the Contship group's extensive port and intermodal operations in Italy.
Management of the shipping line, including chief executive Cecilia Battistello, will remain in place, Canadian Pacific said.

Contship Containerlines generated turnover of $460 million in 1996 from lifting 270,000 twenty foot equivalent units (teu), Canadian Pacific said. This year the firm expects to carry over 300,000 teu.
It is the third major shipping acquisition made by Canadian Pacific in recent years, after Cast and the recently completed deal to buy Lykes Lines.

"The acquisition, coupled with the recently completed acquisition of Lykes Lines, will double CP Ships' revenues to more than C$2 billion and increase its container carryings to more than one million teu per year," Canadian Pacific said. -- Reuters Shipping Desk +44 171 542 4087/4012. Fax 5017.
